Estrela — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Documented concerns are limited and localised rather than widespread. Notícias ao Minuto (24 Nov 2022) reported a PSP patrol intercepting a street-robbery group on Rua Cintura do Porto in Estrela, with one suspect detained; separately, an Observador investigative piece on Lisbon's most problematic areas listed the Madragoa and Fonte Santa neighbourhoods (both within the Estrela freguesia) alongside the old industrial part of Alcântara as flagged zones raised by parish officials. No pattern of daytime tourist-relevant crime was found in current press coverage. Sources checked: Notícias ao Minuto, 24 Nov 2022 – "Suspeito de roubos na via pública detido na Estrela, em Lisboa"; Observador – "Insegurança em Lisboa ou mera perceção? Um raio-X aos pontos mais problemáticos da capital" (Madragoa, Fonte Santa flagged).

Frequently asked questions

Is Estrela safe?

Wandroz currently rates Estrela in Lisbon, Portugal as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal at night. This comes from Wandroz's Level 2 approach: genuine, dated local/national press research for this specific area — not blind guessing, and not a fabricated statistic — but honestly disclosed as press-based rather than an official geolocated crime dataset, since none is publicly available for Lisbon, Portugal at this level of detail. See the methodology page for what was checked and the sources used.

Is Estrela safe at night?

At night, Estrela is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal, based on the same press research. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Estrela's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Lisbon, Portugal) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
